messages:
alex: kicking off a config-only deploy to smooth surge noise for the next change window. small, targeted adjustments: lower per-model concurrency, slight timeout bump, and routing weight shift for EU region. canary to 5% first.

deploy-bot: config-deploy started by alex. target: service=svc-inference, env=prod, change=CONFIG_ONLY, id=4000123456. canary=5% -> 20% -> full by policy. tags=[quiet-window, surge-smoothing]

mira: ping re: rollback criteria and runbook link? want explicit thresholds before we shift beyond 5% :eyes:

alex: yes. rollback triggers: 1) error-rate increase >0.5 percentage points sustained for 10m, 2) p95 latency regresses >350ms vs baseline for 10m, or 3) downstream 5xx spike in any region >= 50% above baseline. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/config-rollbacks

sam: can we pin dedicated customers to model-version v2.3.1 for this window? last time mixing led to kv-cache pressure.

jun: also add a routing drain for old route during the shift. i.e. gradual remove weight over 15m to avoid cold-start storms.

alex: agreed. adding pin and drain. here's the config snippet i'll apply (config-only):

```
# svc-inference/configs/4000123456-quietwindow.yaml
- model: model-x
  max_concurrent: 60  # was 80
  timeout_ms: 10000    # was 8000
  pins:
    dedicated_customers: v2.3.1
- routing:
  eu_weight_adjust: -15%  # shift 15% traffic out of eu to balance
  drain_backoff_min: 15m
- rollout:
  canary: 5%
  ramp: 20% after 10m if healthy
```

mira: looks good. add a metric alert for latency p95 and error-rate with a muted escalation during canary but immediate paging if thresholds hit :+1:

ops-bot: canary health check: sampling collectors enabled, baseline window=60m, alerting hooks wired to #eng-oncall.

deploy-bot: canary deployed to 5% at 4000123490. health checks running.

alex: monitoring dashboards up. watching p50/p95, errors, downstream 5xx, and per-region qps.

ops-bot: canary stable at 5% for 8m. p95 delta +40ms, errors +0.04pp. ok to stage to 20% in 2m unless objections.

mira: ok to go to 20% now from my side. we'll keep the quiet window until 02:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: progressing to 20% at 4000123555.

sam: seeing slight bump in 4xx from eu-west-1 around 4000123568, small absolute counts but notable increase in client-side rejects for long-context requests.

alex: pulling traces now. if it's client behavior we may still proceed but will cap eu routing and revert pins if it worsens.

ops-bot: p95 in eu-west-1 now +420ms vs baseline, error-rate +0.6pp over 5m. hit rollback threshold.

alex: rolling back to previous config. initiating rollback pipeline now. reason: eu latency + error spike. will revert max_concurrent and routing weights.

deploy-bot: rollback started for config-deploy id=4000123456. rolling route weights and model concurrency back to previous state.

deploy-bot: rollback complete at 4000123612. config restored to last-known-good. canary terminated.

taylor: creating follow-up ticket REW-231 to track root cause and additional safety net (per-region request throttles on long-context flows).

mira: good call to rollback. let's pause change-window schedule for the next 24h and re-run load test with dedicated pins in staging.

alex: will do. notes: next attempt after load tests: 1) smaller eu adjustment, 2) increase drain backoff to 20m, 3) add a short-lived per-customer quota for long-context to avoid client retries piling up.

sam: thumbs up. please post postmortem summary in #eng-releases tomorrow.

mira: :ok_hand: thanks everyone.
